S: Erewhon cheddar, apple and chutney stacks

Crisp water crackers stacked with aged cheddar, thin green apple slices and spiced tomato chutney, finished with cracked pepper, served on a steel tray. Slice 200g aged cheddar into thin squares. Core 2 green apples, slice thin and toss with lemon juice. Lay 24 water crackers on a steel tray. Top each with a slice of cheddar, a slice of apple and half a teaspoon of tomato chutney. Crack black pepper over and scatter with thyme leaves.
Rye squares with smoked salmon, crème fraîche and a garnish of dill
Thin rye squares buttered, topped with smoked salmon, crème fraîche, dill and a crack of pepper.
Fresh peach wedges with honey lime syrup and mint
Ripe peaches cut into wedges, drizzled with warm honey and lime juice, torn mint and a pinch of flaky salt.
M: Archer family lemon thyme roast chicken
Castor, as Sean, sitting down at the family table

Dry-brined chicken with lemon and thyme butter under the skin, roasted golden, with pan-roasted potatoes and carrots and a gravy from the juices. Salt a 1.8kg chicken all over and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Mash 50g soft butter with lemon zest and thyme and push it under the breast skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes with 800g halved potatoes and 4 carrots tossed in oil around it. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick.
Lobster tails grilled with garlic parsley butter, lemon vinaigrette salad
Lobster tails split, brushed with garlic and parsley butter, grilled flesh up for 6 to 8 minutes, lemon and a green salad with a sharp vinaigrette.
W: Baked cinnamon peaches under a buttermilk biscuit topping
Sliced peaches with sugar, lemon and cinnamon under a buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 35 minutes.
K: Fresh peach purée topped with chilled prosecco
White peach purée topped with chilled prosecco in tall flutes. Sparkling peach juice for the kids.

s.how: Butter 6 slices rye bread and cut into small squares. Top each with a fold of smoked salmon, using 200g in total, a small spoon of crème fraîche, a dill sprig and a crack of black pepper. Serve cold on a tray.

s.note: Castor could eat a peach for hours
s.how: Cut 4 ripe peaches into wedges and arrange on a plate. Warm 2 tbsp honey with the juice of a lime and drizzle over. Scatter with torn mint and a small pinch of flaky salt. Serve straight away.

m.note: lobster and champagne, he takes over the life
m.how: Split 4 lobster tails lengthways. Brush with 80g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves and chopped parsley. Grill flesh side up for 6 to 8 minutes until just white. Toss salad leaves with a lemon and olive oil vinaigrette and serve alongside.

w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 80g sugar, lemon juice and 1 tsp cinnamon in a baking dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, stir in 150ml buttermilk and drop spoonfuls over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes.

d.how: Blend 3 ripe peaches with 1 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon until smooth and strain. Put 50ml purée in each of 4 flutes and top slowly with chilled prosecco, stirring once.
